services.name: Dive Retrieval
services.desc: A phone slips off the dock. Keys tumble overboard. A wedding ring disappears into the harbour. It's stressful, and you need someone who can actually help - not just sympathise. Tony Sampson is a professional diver based on the South Shore of Nova Scotia. If it's in the water, there's a very good chance he can get it back. Stay where you are if you can. Note landmarks, dock positions, or drop a GPS pin - anything that helps narrow the search area. Tony will discuss the location, water conditions, and depth to plan the best approach. Most dives can be scheduled within 24-48 hours. Tony dives, searches the area, and retrieves your belongings. $250 for the first hour, $150/hour after
